segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Morning sab. Friday hai, toh jaldi khatam karte hain. Release ka status batao.

segments.speaker: Faisal Mirza
segments.text: Mera update: cart wala refactor merge ho gaya, bas ek login crash bacha hai.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Login crash? Woh kab se aa raha hai?

segments.speaker: Faisal Mirza
segments.text: Kal raat se, purane phones pe jab session expire hota hai tab app band ho jata hai.

segments.speaker: Gitanjali Das
segments.text: QA mein bhi dikha, das mein se teen baar reproduce hua purane devices pe.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Ye toh blocker hai. Bina iske release nahi jaa sakti.

segments.speaker: Faisal Mirza
segments.text: Root cause mil gaya hai, token refresh mein null check missing hai. Fix chhota hai.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Faisal, login crash ka fix Monday tak chahiye, uske baad hi build banega.

segments.speaker: Faisal Mirza
segments.text: Haan Monday tak fix aur test dono ho jayega, weekend pe nahi karna padega shayad.

segments.speaker: Prateek Sharma
segments.text: Waise office ki year-end party 24 December ko hai, uske pehle sab release ho jana chahiye.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Party ki date alag hai Prateek, uska release se koi lena dena nahi.

segments.speaker: Prateek Sharma
segments.text: Haha theek hai, bas yaad dila raha tha.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Dark mode ka kya status hai?

segments.speaker: Gitanjali Das
segments.text: Dark mode mein abhi bhi teen screens pe text dikh nahi raha, contrast issue hai.

segments.speaker: Prateek Sharma
segments.text: Design team ne naye colours bheje hain par unko lagane mein do din aur lagenge.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Mujhe lagta hai dark mode is release se bahar karte hain, adha-adhura nahi bhejna.

segments.speaker: Faisal Mirza
segments.text: Haan, feature flag ke peeche rakh dete hain, agle release mein on karenge.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Final: dark mode is release mein nahi jayega, agli release mein.

segments.speaker: Gitanjali Das
segments.text: Theek hai, main uske test cases next sprint mein move kar deti hoon.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Release date pe aate hain. Login fix Monday ko aaya toh Tuesday ko QA, Wednesday release?

segments.speaker: Gitanjali Das
segments.text: Ek din QA kam hai, payments flow ka regression bhi karna hai.

segments.speaker: Prateek Sharma
segments.text: Toh Wednesday 16 December ko release rakhte hain, Tuesday poora QA ke liye.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Haan, release 16 December, Wednesday ko final. Store submission subah karenge.

segments.speaker: Gitanjali Das
segments.text: Payments ka regression main kar lungi, Tuesday ko poora din usi pe.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Gitanjali, regression mein wallet aur card dono flow cover karna.

segments.speaker: Gitanjali Das
segments.text: Haan, dono cover karungi, pichhli baar card wale mein hi bug nikla tha.

segments.speaker: Prateek Sharma
segments.text: Ek idea tha, release ke saath sab users ko push notification campaign bhej dein, naye features ke baare mein.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Naye features hain kahan, dark mode toh hata diya. Notification campaign abhi nahi.

segments.speaker: Faisal Mirza
segments.text: Haan, bina feature ke notification bhejenge toh log uninstall karenge.

segments.speaker: Prateek Sharma
segments.text: Theek hai, notification wala idea drop.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Release notes bhi likhne hain, store pe aur blog pe dono.

segments.speaker: Faisal Mirza
segments.text: Mujhse mat likhwana, meri English notes mein bahut technical ho jaati hai.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Koi likh dega, jisko time mile. Agle hafte ke end tak release notes ready chahiye.

segments.speaker: Gitanjali Das
segments.text: Main dekhti hoon agar Tuesday ke baad time mila, par promise nahi.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Theek hai, koi na koi likh dega, bas tracker mein ticket bana do.

segments.speaker: Prateek Sharma
segments.text: Crash reporting tool ka dashboard bhi koi nahi dekh raha aajkal.

segments.speaker: Faisal Mirza
segments.text: Haan, alerts sab ek channel mein aate hain jo sabne mute kar rakha hai.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Woh retro mein uthaate hain, abhi release pe focus.

segments.speaker: Prateek Sharma
segments.text: Backend ka naya API version deploy ho gaya hai, purana bhi chalu hai ek mahine ke liye.

segments.speaker: Faisal Mirza
segments.text: Achha hai, toh purane app versions nahi tootenge.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Good. Kisi ko kuch aur?

segments.speaker: Gitanjali Das
segments.text: Mere device lab mein do phones ki battery phool gayi hai, unko replace karna hai.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Admin ko mail kar do, main approve kar dungi.

segments.speaker: Gitanjali Das
segments.text: Theek hai.

segments.speaker: Siddhi Rane
segments.text: Chalo, have a good weekend sab. Monday ko Faisal ke fix ke baad baat karte hain.

decisions.fact: Dark mode is left out of this release and ships in the next one.
The release goes out on Wednesday 16 December.

action_items.fact: Faisal fixes and tests the login crash on older phones.
Someone writes the release notes for the store and the blog; nobody named.
Gitanjali runs the payments regression covering wallet and card flows.

distractors.fact: A push notification campaign with the release was suggested and dropped.
24 December is the year-end party, not the login fix's due date.
